description: This file implements a dynamic vector data structure with functions for creation, destruction, clearing, adding, removing, accessing, sizing, and sorting elements.

methods.name: Vector_Create
methods.description: Initializes a new Vector instance, allocating memory and setting initial values.

methods.name: Vector_Destroy
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the vector and optionally destroys contained elements.

methods.name: Vector_Clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the vector and resets its state.

methods.name: Vector_PushBack
methods.description: Adds a new item to the end of the vector, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: Vector_RemoveItem
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the vector, optionally destroying it.

methods.name: Vector_At
methods.description: Returns the element at a specified index.

methods.name: Vector_Size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the vector.

methods.name: Vector_Sort
methods.description: Sorts the vector elements using a provided comparator.
